learning_outcomes.text: elaborate material and technological input data
modeling and optimizing fusion and solid-state welding

syllabus_topics: Introductory seminar. Computational methods and computer technology in welding - possibilities, and applications.
Selection of basic and filer materials. Database.
Prediction of the properties of welded joints, HAZ, and weldability evaluation. (Project No. 1).
Determination and optimization of welding temperature regime.
Calculation and design of welded joints (Project No. 2).
The economy of welding - election of appropriate technologies (Project No. 3).
Introduction to the analytical and numerical solutions of temperature fields during welding.
Numerical solution of temperature and stress fields during welding. Introduction to the computing environment.
Define a thermal source for welding. Input data databases - material, technological. Boundary conditions.
Solution of model problems for fusion and pressure welding (project No. 4).
Software for welding- application programs I
Technological welding procedures, design, generation, and storage (Project No. 5).
